items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I suggested that Miles get Gilly when he was looking for a piano player... I had already called Gilly Coggins and a bass player named Connie Henry to come down to Birdland.

ctx.x: Did he hang with the Sugar Hill gang, so to speak?

During a period, yeah. There was a period when Miles would come up on the Hill. But there were a lot of cats up there, his peers, for him to be around. Roy Haynes lived up that way. So it wouldn’t be strange to see Miles in the square where we used to hang out. He was close with Sonny. There would be a lot of people that would have a relationship with Miles in that area. Gilly Coggins was on the scene. He made the recordings that – I suggested that Miles get Gilly when he was looking for a piano player. There was…
